pages.title: Powered smelting
pages.text: The Smelter runs ordinary furnace recipes at $(bold)10 times the speed$() by default: a normal recipe takes 20 powered ticks (1 second). Speed is configurable.$(br2)Its marble front shows $(bold)input / lightning / output$(). Each slot holds one stack. No fuel slot or GUI is needed.

pages.title: Supply both fluxes
pages.text: Connect Negarite and Posirite flux through cables or combined connectors.$(br2)The Smelter uses $(thing)20 of each flux per active tick$() by default: 400 of each for a normal recipe. Power cost is configurable.$(br2)Progress pauses without power or output space. Idle and blocked machines use no flux. A different recipe resets progress.

pages.title: The two front slots
pages.text: $(li)Right-click the left slot with a smeltable item to insert it.$(li)Left-click either slot to take one item.$(li)Sneak-left-click to take up to a stack.$(li)An empty-hand right-click also takes items.$(br2)The right slot holds the smelting result. Retrieve ingredients from the left slot if you want to change recipes.

pages.title: Item automation
pages.text: $(li)Input: top, left, right and front.$(li)Output: bottom and back.$(br2)These faces follow the machine's orientation. Input faces only accept items with a furnace recipe. Output faces only allow extraction.$(br2)Use an $(l:ariente:automation/first_field)Automation Field$(/l) or another item transport system to deliver ingredients and collect products.

pages.title: Build with a blueprint
pages.text: Put a populated Smelter blueprint in Blueprint Storage next to a Constructor or Auto Constructor. The blueprint stays in the library.$(br2)Ingredients:$(li)1 Black Marble$(li)3 Silver Ingots$(li)1 Circuit$(li)2 Silicon$(li)1 Furnace$(br2)JEI shows the Constructor recipe and matching blueprint.
